entries.name: National Comedy Theatre (NCT San Diego)
entries.summary: San Diego's longest-running professional improv venue, founded in 1999 with over 7,000 shows performed and classes for adults, teens, and specialized groups.
entries.schedule: Shows Thursday through Sunday at 7:30 PM
signals: Repeatedly voted Best Comedy Show in San Diego
Specialized classes for autism and seniors
entries.reasons: A 26-year track record, a venue of its own, a near-nightly schedule, and the broadest class offering make this the metro's strongest entry.

entries.name: Finest City Improv
entries.summary: A large Hillcrest improv school and 21+ venue running a six-level class ladder plus drop-in sessions and a near-nightly show calendar.
entries.schedule: Shows Thursday through Saturday and some Sundays; classes run in ongoing levels with a free intro class
signals: Six progressive class levels plus electives and a graduate program
Free introductory class for new students
entries.reasons: The deepest class programme of the San Diego venues checked, with a near-nightly show calendar, just behind National Comedy Theatre's longer track record.

entries.name: Mockingbird Improv
entries.summary: A nonprofit improv theatre at the Liberty Station arts district offering core training, youth classes, open jams, and a free intro workshop.
entries.schedule: Regular ticketed shows plus Open Jams and Sketch Night
signals: Registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, operating as OTIC Theater Collective
entries.reasons: A genuine community nonprofit with open jams and youth programming, but smaller and newer than the city's two established anchors.
